title: Japanese Chickpea Casserole
description: A unique Japanese-inspired casserole featuring chickpeas, a blend of Italian seasonings, and a touch of creamy oozing goodness.

ingredients.name: oozing
ingredients.notes: may be replaced with melted mozzarella cheese

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine chickpeas, Italian seasoning, and soy sauce.
In a separate pan, heat the cooking oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped green onions and sauté for 1-2 minutes until softened.
Add the oozing and stir until melted.
Combine the chickpea mixture and the green onion mixture in the mixing bowl.
Stir in the cooked rice and sugar.
Transfer the mixture to the casserole dish and top with additional oozing if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the casserole is hot and bubbly.
